--sequences.description: RNA sequence list provided directly from command line. Multiple sequences can be provided as space-separated values. Example: --sequences "GGGUGCGAUCAUACCAGCACUAAUGCCCUCCUGGGAAGUCCUCGUGUUGCACCCCU" "AUGCAUGCAUGCAUGCAUGCAUGCAUGCAUGCAUGCAUGCAUGCAUGCAUGCAUGC"

--sequences_file.description: Path to sequence file. Supports FASTA format (.fasta, .fa) with sequence IDs and sequences, or text format (.txt) with one sequence per line (lines starting with # are ignored). Either --sequences or --sequences_file must be provided.

--model_type.description: Pre-trained model type selection. 'ss' for secondary structure model, 'rna' for general RNA model, 'mrna' for mRNA-specific model.

--device.description: Compute device selection. 'cpu' for CPU computation, 'cuda' for GPU computation. If not specified, automatically selects based on availability (prefers CUDA if available).

--repr_layer.description: Representation layer number to extract embeddings from. RNA-FM model has multiple Transformer layers, different layers capture different levels of features. Default: 12 (last layer, contains richest semantic information).

--mean_pool.description: Whether to apply mean pooling over sequence length dimension. If enabled: output shape is (N, d), each sequence gets a fixed-length vector. If disabled: output shape is (N, L, d), preserves sequence length information.

--batch_size.description: Batch size for processing sequences, i.e., how many sequences to process at once. Default: 16. Increase for faster processing if memory allows, decrease if memory is limited.

--output.description: Output embedding file path, saved as NumPy array format (.npy). If specified, embeddings will be saved to this file and can be loaded using np.load(). Example: --output embeddings.npy

--threshold.description: Pairing probability threshold for determining base pairs from probability map. Default: 0.5. Higher values result in fewer predicted pairs, lower values result in more pairs.

--allow_nc.description: Allow non-canonical base pairs. Default: only allows canonical pairs (AU, UA, GC, CG, GU, UG). If enabled, allows all possible base pairs.

--fasta_folder.description: REQUIRED: Path to folder containing RF*.fasta files. Each FASTA file should represent one RNA family. Files should be named in format RF*.fasta (e.g., RF00001.fasta, RF00002.fasta).

--model_type.description: Pre-trained model type selection. 'ss' for secondary structure model, 'rna' for general RNA model, 'mrna' for mRNA-specific model.

--device.description: Compute device selection. 'cpu' for CPU computation, 'cuda' for GPU computation. If not specified, automatically selects based on availability.

--batch_size.description: Batch size for processing sequences. Default: 16. Increase for faster processing if memory allows.

--output.description: Output image path for saving clustering visualization. Supports formats: .png, .jpg, .pdf, .svg and other matplotlib-supported formats. Example: --output clustering_result.png

--n_components.description: Number of dimensions after t-SNE dimensionality reduction. Default: 2 (for 2D visualization). Can be set to 3 for 3D visualization.

--random_state.description: Random seed for ensuring reproducible t-SNE results. Default: 42. Use same seed to get identical results across runs.

--fasta_folder.description: REQUIRED: Path to folder containing RF*.fasta files for training. Each FASTA file should represent one RNA family. Files should be named in format RF*.fasta (e.g., RF00001.fasta, RF00002.fasta).

--checkpoint_path.description: Path to save the trained classifier model checkpoint. Default: rna_family_classifier.pt. The trained model can be loaded later for prediction.

--model_type.description: Pre-trained model type for generating embeddings. 'ss' for secondary structure model, 'rna' for general RNA model, 'mrna' for mRNA-specific model.

--device.description: Compute device selection. 'cpu' for CPU computation, 'cuda' for GPU computation. GPU strongly recommended for training to significantly speed up the process. If not specified, automatically selects based on availability.

--batch_size.description: Batch size for generating embeddings from pre-trained model. Default: 16. Increase for faster processing if memory allows.

--train_batch_size.description: Batch size for training the classifier. Default: 32. Increase for faster training if memory allows, decrease if memory is limited.

--test_size.description: Proportion of total data to use as test set (for final model evaluation). Default: 0.2 (i.e., 20% of data as test set). Remaining 80% is split into training and validation sets.

--val_size.description: Proportion of training+validation data to use as validation set (for selecting best model). Default: 0.2 (i.e., 20% of training+validation data as validation set).

--seed.description: Random seed for ensuring reproducible data splitting and training process. Default: 42. Use same seed to get identical results across runs.

--num_epochs.description: Number of training epochs, i.e., number of complete passes through the training set. Default: 50. Adjust based on data size and validation performance, typically 30-100 epochs is sufficient.

--lr.description: Learning rate controlling the step size of model parameter updates. Default: 0.001 (1e-3). Adjust based on training loss changes, typically ranges from 1e-5 to 1e-2.

--display_step.description: Interval for displaying training progress (in epochs). Default: 10 (i.e., display training and validation loss/accuracy every 10 epochs). Set to 0 to disable intermediate progress display.

--output.description: Output path for saving training history plots. If directory path (ends with / or exists and is a directory), training history plots will be saved to that directory: loss_history.png (loss curve) and accuracy_history.png (accuracy curve). If file path, will be used as directory path. If not specified, plots will be displayed on screen (requires graphical interface). Example: --output ./training_results/

--data_file.description: REQUIRED: Path to expression data CSV file. CSV file must contain 'Sequence' column with mRNA sequences and 'Value' column with expression values. Optional 'splits' column can specify train/val/test splits. Example format: Sequence,Value,splits

--checkpoint_path.description: Path to save the trained expression prediction model checkpoint. Default: mrna_expression_classifier.pt. The trained model can be loaded later for prediction.

--model_type.description: Pre-trained model type for generating embeddings. 'ss' for secondary structure model, 'rna' for general RNA model, 'mrna' for mRNA-specific model (recommended for mRNA expression prediction).

--device.description: Compute device selection. 'cpu' for CPU computation, 'cuda' for GPU computation. GPU strongly recommended for training to significantly speed up the process. If not specified, automatically selects based on availability.

--batch_size.description: Batch size for generating embeddings from pre-trained model. Default: 16. Increase for faster processing if memory allows.

--train_batch_size.description: Batch size for training the classifier. Default: 32. Increase for faster training if memory allows, decrease if memory is limited.

--value_0.description: Value in CSV file representing low expression. Default: 0. Sequences with this value will be classified as low expression.

--value_2.description: Value in CSV file representing high expression. Default: 2. Sequences with this value will be classified as high expression.

--test_size.description: Proportion of total data to use as test set (only used if CSV file does not contain 'splits' column). Default: 0.2 (i.e., 20% of data as test set).

--val_size.description: Proportion of training+validation data to use as validation set (only used if CSV file does not contain 'splits' column). Default: 0.2 (i.e., 20% of training+validation data as validation set).

--seed.description: Random seed for ensuring reproducible data splitting and training process (only used if CSV file does not contain 'splits' column). Default: 42. Use same seed to get identical results across runs.

--num_epochs.description: Number of training epochs. Default: 50. Adjust based on data size and validation performance, typically 30-100 epochs is sufficient.

--lr.description: Learning rate controlling the step size of model parameter updates. Default: 0.001 (1e-3). Adjust based on training loss changes, typically ranges from 1e-5 to 1e-2.

--display_step.description: Interval for displaying training progress (in epochs). Default: 10 (i.e., display training and validation loss/accuracy every 10 epochs). Set to 0 to disable intermediate progress display. Adjust based on number of epochs - set larger for longer training.

--output.description: Output path for saving training history plots. If directory path (ends with / or exists and is a directory), training history plots will be saved to that directory: loss_history.png (loss curve) and accuracy_history.png (accuracy curve). If file path, will be used as directory path. If not specified, plots will be displayed on screen (requires graphical interface). Example: --output ./training_results/
